scopeFindings: The inspected standard TMDB season 1 contains 38 episodes, while an existing Production episode-group set has 28-episode and 10-episode production-season groups.
The alternative Cours group partitions the same regular episodes into 16, 12 and 10; group existence does not establish that every group is a separate work.
The production-season subgroups reference the standard episode paths, including season/1/episode/29 through season/1/episode/38 for production season 2.
The TV Season account_states description mentions rating, watchlist and favourite status, but its actual schema contains id and per-episode rated results only.
The inspected v3 inventory has rating writes for movie, TV series and TV episode, with no season or episode-group rating write.
Native Part records contain completion flags, not personal ratings; a source episode rating cannot be treated as completion.
Movie and TV series account fields can only be projected to native works with equivalent scope.
v4 custom lists accept movie and tv members and support private owner access; a single v4 user authorization can be converted to a v3 session for needed v3 operations.
TV search results do not contain episode groups. Episode-group sets are listed under a known TV series, and their subgroups and episodes require a separate detail read.
